title: Software Developer (Retool/Low-Code)
description:
At Stackdrop, we help organizations turn messy operations into sleek, scalable internal tools. Using platforms like Retool, we build the kind of software that makes businesses faster, smarter, and a whole lot less frustrated with spreadsheets.

As part of our dev team, you won’t just write code, you’ll craft solutions that help real businesses work better every single day.

  • Have many careers in one company.

  • Enjoy flexibility and autonomy in your work.

  • Learn and grow alongside seasoned architects and product experts.

What will your typical day look like?

  • Build with Retool: Design and ship custom internal apps that automate, simplify, and delight.

  • Shape the data: Design robust schemas, manage SQL databases, and keep performance sharp and scalable.

  • Write clean JavaScript: Build intuitive, maintainable functionality that makes our Retool apps sing.

  • Own your projects: Take part in client discovery, translate technical needs into solutions, and deliver on time with quality.

  • Test like you mean it: Debug and QA your own work to ensure smooth, reliable deployments.

  • Collaborate & level up: Pair with architects, PMs, and teammates to learn fast, ask questions, and master new tools and integrations.

About the team

We’re a growing agency that thrives on solving real-world problems for SMEs and enterprises. Our work spans automation, integrations, and internal platforms, always with a focus on delivering practical impact.

At Stackdrop, developers aren’t stuck in silos. You’ll have ownership, visibility, and the chance to influence how we build, not just what we build.

Enough about us, let’s talk about you

  • Excellent spoken and written English, with the confidence to communicate clearly with clients and teammates.

  • Strong JavaScript skills, with the willingness (or eagerness) to master Retool.

  • Proficient in database design, SQL, and data management best practices.

  • Independent problem-solver, able to manage your own priorities in an agile workflow.

  • Meticulous about testing, QA, and documentation.

  • Bonus if you:

    • Love learning new tools and frameworks quickly

    • Have experience with integrations, APIs, or automation platforms

    • Geek out over building tools that make businesses run smoother

Our promise to you

You’ll get to work on meaningful projects, sharpen your technical chops, and have a direct impact on how businesses operate day-to-day. No endless feature bloat, no busywork - just solving real problems with smart software.

We value curiosity, accountability, and collaboration. You’ll be trusted with ownership and encouraged to experiment, fail fast, and learn faster.

If you can refactor chaos into clean queries, ship tools that make life easier, and still find joy in a well-placed console.log ~ we want you in our repo 🚀
